data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/entity-schema.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/schemas/<Entity>.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). v70: the field map is `properties` OR the legacy `fields` (both conventions coexist in the data; at least one is required). Each entry must carry `type`. Necessity is a single boolean `required` (true = user must supply, false/absent = need not); `readonly` marks non-input system fields; `auto_generated` (implies required:false) marks app-auto-filled createables. The legacy `optional` flag is FORBIDDEN (the runtime never read it).
changelog: 2.1.0 (2026-07-09): necessity axis collapsed to `required: boolean` + `auto_generated`; `optional` forbidden (not:{required:[optional]}); `read_only`→`readonly` (camelCase, matches data + runtime).
2.0.0 (2026-06-08): v70 shape — accept `properties` map (new) OR `fields` map (legacy); per-field `read_only`/`field_type`/`label`/`sample` allowed (additionalProperties:true).
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled.

title: Spec 70 — schemas/<Entity>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS entity schema file (e.g. manifests/gmail/schemas/Message.yaml) after _meta is stripped. A `properties` or `fields` map is required.

FieldMap.description: Map of field name (e.g. Subject, To) → field definition. Each entry must have type; label/field_type/readonly/required/auto_generated/primary/ref/widget are optional. `optional` is FORBIDDEN — necessity is the single `required` boolean.

type.description: Field type (text, email, list<email>, id, string, …).

widget.description: Widget id used to read/write this field.

readonly.description: Non-input system field (Id, formula, auto-number); dropped from the fillable set.

required.description: Necessity/presence (OpenAPI `required`) — on every field. Writable: must-supply-on-create. readonly: always-present-in-reads (readOnly+required, e.g. the PK id). true|false. (No `optional`.)

auto_generated.description: Createable but the app auto-fills it (OwnerId, CreatedDate); user MAY override. Implies required:false.
